critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: Multiple /api/auth/me 401 console errors on public pages for anonymous visitors — expected, but could be silenced by treating 401 as anonymous state (already the intent). Not a defect.
Non-blocking: 'preserveAspectRatio: Trailing garbage, xMinYMin none' SVG warnings (likely from a third-party embed/image). Consider cleaning attribute if the offending SVG is app-owned.
Non-blocking: Meta Pixel warning 'Invalid PixelID: null' when pixel id is not set — guard the pixel init to skip when id is empty.
